official: 羽村市税賦課徴収条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 市税の控除や固定資産税の規定を見直す
summary: 地方税法などの改正に合わせ、羽村市の市税条例を改正します。個人住民税の控除や特定暗号資産の課税、固定資産税の免税点などに関する規定を見直します。
changes: 公的年金等を受給する人が扶養親族等申告書を提出する義務の範囲を見直す
特定一般医療費薬品等購入費に係る医療費控除の特例期限を撤廃する
寄附金税額控除に関わる復興特別所得税の課税期間を延ばし、防衛特別所得税の創設を反映するほか、特定暗号資産取引の課税を見直す
固定資産税の免税点を改める
who: 公的年金等を受給する人
医療費控除や寄附金税額控除を受ける人
特定暗号資産を取引する人や固定資産税の納税者
why: 地方税法などを改正する法律の施行に合わせるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises city tax deductions and fixed asset tax rules
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hamura City Tax Imposition and Collection Ordinance
en.summary: In line with amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws, Hamura City will amend its city tax ordinance. It will review provisions on deductions for individual resident tax, taxation of specified crypto-assets, the tax-exempt threshold for fixed asset tax, and other matters.
changes: Revises the scope of people receiving public pensions and other benefits who must submit a declaration of dependants and other information
Removes the time limit for the special medical expense deduction for purchases of certain medicines

Extends the period for levying the Special Reconstruction Income Tax in connection with the donation tax credit, reflects the creation of the Special Defense Income Tax, and revises taxation of transactions in specified crypto-assets
Changes the tax-exempt threshold for fixed asset tax
who: People receiving public pensions and other benefits
People claiming the medical expense deduction or donation tax credit
en.why: The city says this is to align with the enforcement of laws amending the Local Tax Act and other laws.
